selection: Deliberate exact-package representation and shared bounded statistical state after closing-name residual headroom failed.
hypothesis: A magnitude distribution and shared nonzero sign distribution can represent exact INT4 weights more cheaply than fifteen separate adaptive symbol counts.
mechanism: q=symbol-7; magnitude=abs(q); sign0 positive, sign1 negative. Zero has no sign event. Magnitude priors [1,2,2,2,2,2,2,2], sign priors [1,1]. Reset per tensor; update after complete weight; each total rescales at65536 using ceil(count/2). Existing Q11 coder, metadata and non-INT4 payloads remain.
prior_caveat: Unquantized joint prior is uniform over15 symbols; different tree topology can change rounded Q11 probabilities.
controls: P unchanged adaptive format; K new count bookkeeping with unchanged parent archive; D magnitude/shared-sign format.
population: Synthetic only: all encodings and exceptional bytes, empty tensors/documents, zero weights, independent signs, magnitude-dependent signs, resets and rescaling.
allowance: One fixed factorization and synthetic suite; no parameter selection, trained model or corpus access.
required: P/K and authoritative parent archive identity
immutable source preimages and measured executable sizes
next_decision: Correctness pass permits freezing a separately published complete-model byte comparison. Reject an implementation defect before model execution. Trained model savings and integrated loader economics remain unmeasured.
